name: marker
author: lumine-code
description: Host the marker layers drawn on the scrollbar and minimap.

cursors.title: Cursors
cursors.description: The built-in layer showing cursor positions and selections on the overview maps.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the cursors layer on the overview maps.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Hide the layer on a map while the cursor count exceeds this value scaled by that map's threshold scale. Zero means no limit.

showAll.title: Show all cursors
showAll.description: Display all cursors or only the last one.

showSelections.title: Show selections
showSelections.description: Display selected ranges as full width markers.

inactiveShow.title: Show in inactive editors
inactiveShow.description: Display cursor markers in editors that are not currently focused.
